verdict.rationale: Khoj docs show it can 'generate and run simple Python code' for data analysis/plots (khoj-docs-13, khoj-docs-32), which is a limited exec surface, but there is no evidence of running arbitrary shell commands or editing files directly on the user's machine — file interaction is limited to reading/indexing shared files for context (khoj-docs-18, khoj-docs-33). Missing for 10: general command execution, file write/edit capability, and any hands-on evidence of the code-execution sandbox actually modifying local files.
